definitions.explanation: A light, narrow boat propelled by paddles. Also refers to the sport of canoeing, which includes both canoe and kayak disciplines in Japanese usage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧カヌー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}った→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: I rode a canoe on the lake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧カヌー⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I participated in a canoeing experience during summer vacation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}して→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧カヌー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The river current is gentle, so even beginners can enjoy canoeing with ease.

notes:
From English "canoe." In Japanese sports terminology, カヌー is the umbrella term covering both canoe (kneeling, single-blade paddle) and kayak (sitting, double-blade paddle) disciplines. It is an Olympic sport, and Japan has competitive athletes in both categories.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カヌー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to ride a canoe
- カヌー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漕|こ}ぐ→漕ぐ：04264_kogu⟧: to paddle a canoe
- カヌー⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: canoeing experience
- カヌー⟦{競技|きょうぎ}→競技：02606_kyougi⟧: canoe sport, canoeing competition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦カヤック→カヤック：27296_kayakku⟧: kayak — a specific type with a closed deck and double-bladed paddle
- ⟦ボート→ボート：00018_booto⟧: boat — a general term; in Japanese sports context, often refers to rowing
- {丸木舟|まるきぶね}: dugout canoe — a traditional carved-out log boat
